cells.tense: The whole self is igniting before it knows what for, and the pattern is visible at once.
cells.act: keep following the star after everything that has happened
cells.ask: Go toward a direction you chose before the noise, for one week, without asking for proof you are right.
cells.core:
In a place where you see how things work beneath their surfaces, something is starting that hasn't aimed itself yet. The pattern is already whole — you can read the mechanism of a thing without needing its content. What you shine from is that real development: the cultivated thing reached its completion, so the light isn't borrowed. You are not trying to prove you can see it. You can.

Go on toward what you picked when it was still only a shape in the air, through another week of uncertainty. What it asks of you is giving up being told you're right. The choice already knows; the week is just letting it get there. Move on what you already named, past all the noise, and that is the following.
cells.sheetLine: You can see the pattern and still go another week on the choice.
cells.verb: catching fire before there is anything to point it at
cells.place: where the pattern shows itself apart from any of its instances

cells.tense: You will have charted the whole mechanism before anything has caught fire, and the seeing will have replaced the starting.
cells.act: lay every piece of it out where you can see all of it at once
cells.ask: Spread the parts of whatever you're about to begin where you can view them together, then leave them without a verdict.
cells.core:
Where the pattern shows apart from its instances, you are already charting how a thing works before it has ignited. The spark gets subjected to a diagram; the diagram is finished before the fire has started. That much seeing stops being clarity and becomes a habit of postponing the start. Little stays hidden, and little gets to be unknown for even an hour.

Spread the parts of it where all of them are visible together. Then don't reach for the last word. Seeing it whole is not the same as seeing it done, and finishing the picture is not the same as choosing a direction. The light you shine without ego doesn't need a verdict to be real. Let the picture be complete and stay open.
cells.sheetLine: You will have seen it whole before it has had a chance to start.
cells.verb: catching fire before there is anything to point it at
cells.place: where the pattern shows itself apart from any of its instances

cells.tense: It had already caught fire, and you are still standing at the door it left through.
cells.act: name every feeling in it on one page, none of them crossed out
cells.ask: Write every feeling you have about a thing you once started on one page, crossing none out.
cells.core:
In the place where you read the pattern, there's not much charge left moving through it. Something began, and you're still at the threshold it already passed, looking back at it. The mechanism is legible, but it isn't warm. You can explain how a thing works and not be in it. The pattern without content has turned into a way of staying out of the feeling that would point it.

Write every feeling you have about a thing you once started on one page. Don't cross any of them out. Let the whole rainbow of what you feel about it be present before you move on. Feeling the whole of it is the charge the pattern needs to catch again — not pushed into the starved place, but arriving from the side. Your reading of it deepens when it has colour in it.
cells.sheetLine: It already began, and you're still at the door it went through.

cells.tense: The ignition is happening under your hands in a pattern you say you only noticed.
cells.act: let the satisfaction of a finished thing land
cells.ask: Pick what you already brought into being, and for a moment let finishing it be enough.
cells.core:
You read the pattern, you see the mechanism, and something in you has been catching fire in directions you call accidental. The beginning is happening through you, and by your account, you just watched. People near your ideas have been feeling the light and not believing the story that it arrived by itself. They don't need to.

Pick what you already brought into being. Let the satisfaction of it land. Don't reach past it toward the next shape. A vision that was imagined all the way through and felt all the way through is already here; the dreaming is real because the experience behind it got absorbed. Taking the satisfaction is how the one who started it gets named. The next ignition will be easier to own, and the one after that you'll have stopped noticing as separate from you.
cells.sheetLine: The starting is yours while you say you only watched it.
cells.verb: catching fire before there is anything to point it at
cells.place: where the pattern shows itself apart from any of its instances
